sidebar-layout.$description: SidebarLayout's component tokens. Each one is an optional override: set the CSS variable (--sidebar-layout-<name>) on the page, a container or one SidebarLayout, and every one inside follows. Unset, it uses the shared token it references here; tools/test/foundation.mjs checks that bundle.css uses exactly these defaults.

side-width.$description: The narrow column's width side by side, when sidebarWidth isn't given (256px).

gap.$description: The space between the columns when gap isn't given (24px).
